summary: Root Heart is the central chamber of Crystal Root, where all crystal veins converge. Divine resonance pulses through the chamber, forming living constructs and shaping the metaphysical lattice of Underfoot.
history: Root Heart formed when Brell infused the crystal lattice with divine resonance.
The chamber became the anchor point for all crystal veins.
Heart Guardians emerged from the first resonance pulses.
The Heart Resonant developed sentience as the lattice expanded.
